entities.description: A close-up view of a white flagpole with a gold finial at the top, partially obscured by a statue in the foreground. The flagpole is positioned vertically against a clear blue sky, with a blue flag visible in the background.

A close-up, eye-level shot of a classical marble statue of a male figure wearing a green laurel wreath and draped in a toga, holding a scroll in his right hand. The statue has a serene expression and is positioned in front of a blurred blue flag on a pole against a clear sky.

clothing.details: draped over left shoulder, fastened with a circular brooch at the waist
